name: Ulanzi TC001 (AWTRIX NG)
description: Show your FiestaBoard pages on a Ulanzi TC001 running AWTRIX NG, as an app in its rotation, over your local network.
author: FiestaBoard contributors

host.title: Clock address
host.description: The TC001's IP address or local name on your network (for example 192.0.2.60 or awtrixng-a1b2c3.local). Use Find my clock, or type it in.

app_name.title: App name
app_name.description: The name of the app the board shows up as in the clock's rotation. Letters, digits, - and _, at most 32. Empty: FiestaBoard.

show_on_change.title: Show on change
show_on_change.description: Switch the clock to the board whenever its page changes, so the change and its transition are seen. Off, the board waits for its turn in the rotation.

duration_s.title: Display time
duration_s.description: Seconds the board stays on screen in the rotation. Leave empty for the clock's own app duration.

font.title: Text size
font.description: Small draws 3×5-pixel letters on 1 row × 8 columns: more text fits, best in uppercase. Large draws 5×7-pixel letters on 1 row × 5 columns: easier to read from across a room. Changing it resizes the board and the pages shown on it.

tile_gap.title: Tile style
tile_gap.description: Gaps keeps the one-pixel line between neighbouring color tiles, as on a split-flap board. Seamless lights it when both are the same color, so a row of tiles reads as one solid bar.

block_padding.title: Block padding
block_padding.description: 1 pixel grows the background of highlighted text one pixel on every side, so the letters never touch its edge.

fade_style.title: Fade style
fade_style.description: How the Fade transition looks. Through black streams six pixel frames through black in about a second. Blend cross-fades the two pages.

username.title: User name
username.description: Only when the clock's web UI asks for a password (authEnabled in AWTRIX NG's settings).

password.title: Password
password.description: Only when the clock's web UI asks for a password.

actions.label: Find my clock
actions.description: Looks for an AWTRIX NG clock on your local network. Only devices on your network are contacted.

subnet.title: Network to search
subnet.description: Optional, for example 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to search the network FiestaBoard is on.

hint_host.title: Address you opened FiestaBoard at
hint_host.description: Optional. The network of this address is searched first.
